workspace_trust.description: JavaScript configuration files will NOT be loaded.

virtual_workspaces.description: In virtual workspaces, it is not possible to load the CSpell configuration from a JavaScript file. The configuration must be in a JSON, JSONC, or YAML file. Any configuration that relies upon `node_modules` will not be loaded.

constraints: Metadata detection does not activate the extension.
Command arguments and return types are unknown unless the provider declares them.

workspace_trust.description: JavaScript configuration files will NOT be loaded.

virtual_workspaces.description: In virtual workspaces, it is not possible to load the CSpell configuration from a JavaScript file. The configuration must be in a JSON, JSONC, or YAML file. Any configuration that relies upon `node_modules` will not be loaded.
